# design/Sol/ — Sol compatibility (generated)

**Generated by `tools/gen_sol_compat.py` — do not hand-edit.** Every patch here is gated on
`SolSystem`, so on RealSolarSystem this folder does nothing.

AXE is balanced on RSS. Sol (RSS-Reborn) replaces RSS but registers the ModuleManager pass
`SolSystem`, never `RealSolarSystem`, and builds its bodies at `:FOR[SolSystem]`, which sorts after
`RP-0` and `RP-AXE`. AXE's body patches therefore run before the bodies exist (or never), and Sol's
own copies of a few RSS-side configs have drifted. These files put a Sol career back on the RSS
numbers:

| file | what it restores | source |
|---|---|---|
| `AxeSolBodyScience.cfg` | per-body science multipliers + thresholds, Earth sub-40 km removal, RSS's Sun boundary | twin of `seed/Science/BodyScienceParams.cfg` + `design/Science/EarthScienceRemoval.cfg`; the Sun from the RSS cache |
| `AxeSolGasGiantEmissive.cfg` | Saturn/Uranus/Neptune no longer cook orbiters | twin of `design/AxeGasGiantEmissiveFix.cfg` |
| `AxeSolScanners.cfg` | SCANsat altitudes + EC (Sol triples them all) | RSS dev instance's merged cache |
| `AxeSolStations.cfg` | RealAntennas ground-station antennas (Sol's copy lacks the DSN Ka band) | RSS dev instance's merged cache |
| `AxeSolResources.cfg` | outer-planet resource maps Sol does not ship | RealSolarSystem/ResourceConfigs via the cache |

Re-run `python tools/gen_sol_compat.py` after an RP-1 seed sync, a change to the twinned files, or a
dev-instance rebuild; `--check` fails when a file is stale. The measurements behind each file and
the caveats that are not fixed here are in `docs/SOL.md`.
